A Columbia physicist says consciousness is physical, machines will reach it, and their rights need settling now.

 
 
 
Coming in Hot

AI Tools of the Day

  7. 🤝 Jason AI watches the edits you make to Jason’s drafts and turns the ones you repeat into rules he follows on his own next time.

 

🦾 Launch your AI tool on the #1 AI tools marketplace.

 
 
 
Interesting AI

Ideas don’t wait for you to find your phone. They land mid-walk, mid-shower, mid-sentence, and by the time the screen is open the thought has already moved on.

Spark Ring replaces the notes app with a double tap on your finger. Say the thing out loud. The transcription runs on your phone and never touches the cloud, and it files what you said as a note, a to-do, or a reminder.

It catches the time along with the task. So the thing you muttered on Tuesday comes back Thursday as a buzz on your finger, not one more notification you swipe past without reading.

Check it out here ➜

From the Source

🗣️ Confucius4-TTS clones a voice from one clip, then speaks it in 14 languages with the accent gone and the emotion intact.

🎬 MoneyPrinterTurbo turns one keyword into a finished short video and posts it straight to TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.
